name: setNew
description: Creates a new set. Sets hold unique values; adding a duplicate is ignored. By default the set is unordered and case-sensitive. Pass an array to create a set from its values with duplicates removed.

params.name: data
params.description: ordered (keeps insertion order), nocase (case-insensitive) or ordered-nocase, or an array of initial values.
